RESIDENCE ZONE NO. 1-(R-1 ZONE)
A. In an R-1 Zone, only the following buildings, structures and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) Single family detached dwellings, with floor space of four hundred (400) square feet or more.
(2) Churches and religious buildings, public, private or parochial schools offering courses in general education, accredited colleges, libraries, community assembly halls, governmental buildings. Also public utility buildings or structures if the Board of Adjustment, as hereinafter created, upon appeal, finds that their location is necessary to the service of the district and approved the location and design.
(3) Publicly owned or publicly operated parks, play spaces and other recreational facilities with customary incidental buildings, structures and uses.
B. In an R-1 Zone, no building or structure shall exceed thirty-five (35) feet in height.
C. In an R-1 Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard-depth, forty (40) feet or conform to existing setbacks.
(2) a. Side yards—width, ten (10%) percent of the lot width, within the block. 
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the required depth of the front yard.
(3) Rear yard—depth, fifteen (15) feet or ten percent (10%) of lot depth—whichever is greater.
RESIDENCE ZONE NO. 2-(R-2 ZONE)
A. In an R-2 Zone, only the following buildings, structures, and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in an R-1 Zone.
(2) Two-family detached dwellings, having a separate outdoor or vestibule entrance on the ground floor, front and rear for each family, and having the floor area of four hundred (400) square feet or more for each family.
(3) Pairs of single-family semi-detached dwellings, where the attachment extends not over seventy-two (72) feet deep, including porches in such measurement, and having a floor area of four hundred (400) square feet or more for each family.
(4) Three or four family manor-group dwellings.
B. In an R-2 Zone, no building or structure shall exceed forty-five (45) feet in height.
C. In an R-2 Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard—depth, twenty (20) feet or conform to existing setback.
(2) a. Side yards—width, ten (10%) percent of the lot width, within the block. 
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the required depth of the front yard.
(3) Rear yard—depth, fifteen (15) feet or ten (10%) percent of lot depth, whichever is greater.
RESIDENCE ZONE NO. 3-(R-3 ZONE)
A. In an R-3 Zone, only the following buildings, structures, and uses shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in an R-2 Zone.
(2) Two or three family semi-detached dwellings; provided that each family unit has floor space of four hundred (400) square feet or more, and a separate outdoor or vestibule entrance, front and rear, except, that in case of conversion or remodeling of existing buildings, the separate entrances may be from a common hall or stairhall.
(3) Detached multiple dwellings.
(4) Hospitals or other similar institutions for human beings for other than contagious or mental diseases if in detached buildings twenty (20) feet or more distant from any line of another lot.
(5) Detached or semi-detached buildings used for studio, office or laboratory for doctors, dentists, or other professions.
(6) Commercial, vocational or special schools for normal people.
B. In an R-3 Zone, no building or structure shall exceed forty-five (45) feet in height unless each required side yard is increased in width by two (2) feet for every unit of ten (10) feet of additional height above forty (40) feet.
C. In an R-3 Zone, each lot shall have front, side and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard—depth, fifteen (15) feet or conform to existing setbacks.
(2) a. Side yards—width, ten (10%) percent of the lot width, within the block. 
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the required depth of the front yard.
(8) Rear yard—depth, ten (10) feet or ten (10%) percent of the lot depth, whichever is greater.
RESIDENCE ZONE NO. 4-(R-4 ZONE)
A. In an R-4 Zone, only the following buildings, structures and use shall be permitted: 
(1) All buildings, structures and uses permitted in an R-3 Zone.
(2) Attached single family dwellings.
(3) Group dwellings.
(4) Detached or semi-detached buildings, used for central offices or headquarters of a regional nature for public, quasi-public, civic, fraternal, financial or business agencies, involving no manufacture, buying or selling of goods or manual services other than supplies incidental to such permitted principal uses and involving no street or window display.
(5) Detached or semi-detached lodging or boarding houses, rooming houses, fraternities, or so-rorities.
(6) Banks, insurance agencies, realty offices, building and loan societies and other like uses housed in detached or semi-detached buildings.
B. In an R-4 Zone, no building or structure shall exceed forty-five (45) feet in height, unless each required side yard is increased in width by one and one half (1½) feet for every unit of ten (10) feet of additional height above forty (40) feet.
C. In an R-4 Zone, each lot shall have front, side, and rear yards of not less than the depth or width indicated below: 
(1) Front yard—depth, ten (10) feet or conform to existing setback, within the Block.
(2) a. Side yards—width, ten (10%) percent of the lot width. 
b. The width of a side yard abutting a major street shall equal the required depth of the front yard.
